effect: The leaf's reflected light reaches the retina, and nerve signals carry information to the brain. The final goal is complete.
reaction: It was satisfying to see the assembled parts form a complete route from leaf to brain.

mostWorthwhile.text: Combining the light-sensitive cells with nerve cells was worthwhile: it introduced the retina and optic nerve and showed how their jobs connect.

leastWorthwhile.text: Connecting the finished eye to the body felt like a predictable assembly step, though it was needed to reach the brain.

surprise.text: The retina and optic nerve were new names to me; the picture made it clear that the nerve is a bundle of fibres leaving the light-sensitive lining.

arbitrary.text: Nothing felt particularly arbitrary. The pictures and goals explained the pairings, although they did not explain in detail how light becomes a nerve signal.

continue.text: I would choose to try another chapter: following light from the leaf to the brain gave the assembly a clear purpose, though most pairings were fairly predictable.
